validation.message: Depth scene geometry matches tutorial setup

solver.message:
Implemented the water depth visualization scene in [main.tscn](/workspace/scenes/main.tscn).

It now includes:

- `WorldEnvironment` with a procedural sky and glow enabled
- `DirectionalLight3D` with shadows enabled
- `Water` MeshInstance3D using:
  - 10×10 `PlaneMesh`
  - 20×20 subdivisions
  - ShaderMaterial referencing `res://scenes/WaterShader.tres`
- `Background` Node3D containing exactly five green sphere MeshInstance3D nodes at the requested positions
- `Camera3D` with FOV `30` and Y position `1.0`, framed to show all spheres
- Forward+ rendering enabled in [project.godot](/workspace/project.godot) to support glow and successful rendering

Validation completed successfully with Godot 4.4.1. A Forward+ render capture showed the water plane and all five green spheres in view.
